record.summary: Fitted payload on the unmodified card's native tape (transport_correction, estimator_cap.py:8534). Matt (2026-09-01): derive everything, do not resort to learning - F2J is a stopgap to be RETIRED, not refit: whatever it captures must be re-derived as a mechanism (its residual is the map of what the closure still misses). Price F2J-off first (teammate A); then attribute its gain to N1.2/N2/N3 leaves as they are solved. T-24/T-25/T-28: F2J-off host 8.59e-8 (r35) / 7.80e-8 (r100) vs F2J-on 2.68e-8 / 2.75e-8. Matt (2026-09-01): "[quote removed]" - derived source preferred only when it scores as well. Gate for any card change = F2J-on score with the tape feature entering_cp_rank held fixed. Refit protocol: public_deploy_composition_prep_v1/run_joint_refit.py (~4.2 h CPU; last joint refit flat). T-35 (teammate D, experiments/p2_width1024_depth16/public_g22_operator_features_v1/LANE.md): the engine's per-layer variance supply and carried k3/k4 deltas are rich, cross-net-transferable operator features (held-out R^2 of the per-layer variance error 11%->44%, skew 34%->66%); refit priced 10.8/17.5/23.4 raw (r35/r100/r150, same-sample frame). Refit on MPS (fit is torch; tape generation numpy ~2.5-4.7 h; torch shim 1-2 days). T-43: on a v-corrected host the deployed payload still helps (-21% both nets, independent scoring); once k3/k4 are corrected the host is exact and the payload over-corrects (+65% / +164%) -> any correction beyond v needs the refit (MPS) or the payload off. T-48: the deployed payload scores +202% / +397% on the k4-rescaled host - it breaks on ANY corrected host - so the REFIT is the gating step of the route (teammate D: 200-row tapes with the corrected numpy card two at a time ~2.5 h, fit on MPS, score r35/r100 on independent truths). Bank arithmetic: rescaled host 5.4e-8 x (1 - 0.69) ~ 1.7e-8 if the refit keeps the deployed payload's efficiency. Refit rounds (teammate D): round 1 on the k4-table host (200 rows two at a time, fit on MPS, 20-net cross-role gate, candidate cand_k4panel_refit_v1.py, whest validate, r35/r100 + 8-net panel); round 2 on the k4+k3 host (cand_k4k3panel_refit_v1.py). If the refit keeps ~2/3 efficiency: ~1.3e-8, under the bank line. The deployed payload scores +150-350% on any corrected host. T-59..T-61: round-1 refit on the k4 host (frozen protocol, CPU; MPS impossible for the sha-pinned float64 J source): valid-40 removal 34.7% vs 37.7% on the old host; cross-role gate 20/20; r35 +2.1% / r100 +14.2% WORSE than the deployed card; warm starts worse; candidate cand_k4panel_refit_v1.py whest-validated, NOT fired. The operator already corrects 70-79% of the tables' effect; any corrected host breaks the deployed payload. Round 2 (k4+k3 host) runs unattended as the last formal check. Closed as measured: refits do not convert state corrections that the tape can predict. Rounds 2-3 (T-65/T-67): refit on the two-table host (r100 +23%) and the extended-feature operator (r35 -4.0% in-sample, r100 +21%) both fail the board and the perpendicular judge. Refits cannot convert state corrections the tape or the carrier features can predict. T-73: EXPLAINED - the deployed operator's correction is 84% the fourth-order plane defect's effect (corr +0.91); the derived plane chain reproduces it without learning.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when the derived mechanisms match or beat F2J's price and the card ships without a learned payload.
record.goal_path_summary: The estimator's one learned patch is a placeholder: the goal is to explain and derive what it corrects, then remove it.
